objects.name: Detection technique coverage: asl-aws-detect-users-creating-keys-with-encrypt-policy-without-mfa
objects.description: The following analytic detects the creation of AWS KMS keys with an encryption policy accessible to everyone, including external entities. It leverages AWS CloudTrail logs from Amazon Security Lake to identify `CreateKey` or `PutKeyPolicy` events where the `kms:Encrypt` action is granted to all principals.
